A personal world. Interiors · Objects · Bespoke About the Studio → Scroll There are interiors that look beautiful. And there are interiors that feel like you. Mandana Gaulier begins with the person who will live in a room: the life they have built, the objects they treasure and the way they want to feel at home. Drawing by hand, she works through rooms, joinery and individual pieces until those personal details have a place.
